name: Sjnulttjie raststuga-Rävfallsstugan
description: Sjnulttjie raststuga to Rävfallsstugan. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Route geometry preserves a small source-boundary/service-zone gap around the shelter handoff. Treat the map line as planning-grade and inspect endpoint notes before navigation.
STF page summary says Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs has 8 stages/days, but current detailed list shows 9 and includes Sjnulttjie shelter-Rävfallsstugan as Stage 8 and Rävfallsstugan-Ammarnäs as Stage 9.
STF uses one 27 km stage Sjnulttjie-Rävfallsstugan. Naturkartan splits official route at länsgränsen, with Adolfström-länsgränsen including Sjnulttjie and Länsgränsen-Rävfallsstugan as 14 km.

Public pages may still repeat 9 May-14 Aug seasonal access wording, but section 19 targeted follow-up and section 20 replacement rules lane found the hiker access ban was time-limited through 2019 and no active 2026 renewal/polygon was found.

Section 19 research identifies Tjålmejaure SPA as SE0820714; section 20 replacement rules lane wrote SE0820434, which appears likely to be a transcription error or confusion with another Natura watercourse context.
Official endpoint should be Rävfallsstugan. Rävfallstugan appears on some Länsstyrelsen/Vindelfjällen link labels as spelling variant/typo, and Rävfallet refers to nearby waterfall/local feature.
Field reports mention broken/under-construction bridges near forest-line/Rävfalls descent, but current official facility layer still lists bridges and no official 2026 closure was found.
